value.rationale: The first nonvanishing finite-alphabet discretization error in a sharp operator projection norm changes sign with ternary dimension modulo three, while the quaternary error has a different stable negative coefficient. This identifies a quantitative arithmetic obstruction invisible to the common Gaussian leading limit, for three natural first-frequency approximation spaces. The contribution is the systematic signed comparison and exact correction scale, not routine binomial moments in isolation.
